summary: Pre-TestFlight sanity check (web, mobile viewport 390x844). Goal: confirm no regression appeared after EAS Update 'Apple 3.1.1 compliance - Reader App pattern' was published. Static audit on the 8 modified files: IS_IOS_NATIVE is still imported & used (counts: claim-wedding 2, unlock 2, subscription 2, library 4, home 4, profile 5, wedding/[clientId] 3, video/[id] 3) and IOSReaderGate is still imported in the 3 full-gate screens (claim-wedding, unlock, subscription = 2 occurrences each: 1 import + 1 JSX). Live web checks all passed: admin login OK; Home shows open-unlock-btn (key) + unlock-band + footer-unlock; Library shows library-unlock-btn; Profile shows profile-unlock-btn (label 'Saisir un code de déblocage'), 'Gérer mon abonnement', 'Portail Stripe', and the iOS info notice is NOT shown on web; /wedding/hanifa-et-dali anonymous → wedding-unlock-btn visible, admin → 'Galerie photo (Admin)' wedding-photos-btn + 'Gérer les codes d'accès (Admin)' invite-friends-btn visible; /subscription, /unlock, /claim-wedding all render their native content (pricing / code-form / autocomplete) and ios-gate-back is absent on web (gate correctly returns null). Zero new pageerror — only pre-existing deprecation warnings (expo-av, shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents, resizeMode) already logged in iteration_4. Initial mismatches on 'profile: Saisir code' and 'wedding-unlock-btn' (admin) were testing artefacts (exact text differs / admin auto-unlocks) — re-tested by testID and anonymous flow → both PASS. Nothing has regressed; the build is safe for the user's TestFlight manual test.
